email:
Dear Complaints Team,

I am writing to make a formal complaint. We reserved Plot 14 at Orchard Rise on 9 January 2025 and completed on 27 June 2025. In October I reported that the kitchen worktop had split along a joint and the bath panel had come away. The customer care team agreed a repair within four weeks. Nobody has attended, two booked visits were cancelled on the morning, and my last two emails have had no reply. I have now reported this three times.

Please treat this as a formal complaint about the delay and the lack of communication.

Helen Marsh
why: demo: explicit formal complaint with full dates; missed agreed timescale
